text:
Silent snail…

Silent snail
in search of the fire
of the obsidian net
where memories fall

from the tiny mirror,
time's scribble,
a taut string of
moonlight

in awakened arpeggios.

Bright and profound shadow,
the margin of your body.

translation.title: Farewell to Pedro Salinas
